desc:
⛳ GOLF A LUCKY EGG ⛳

Swing your club and launch your egg down a canyon of 35 wild zones! The farther it flies, the luckier it gets 🍀 Steer through lucky clovers, land deep in the canyon and watch your egg grow up to 250x before it hatches!

🐉 Hatch rare pets: Secret, Eternal and the Divines
💰 Put your pets on your plot and earn money every second
🏌️ Train your power and unlock 12 epic clubs to hit even farther
✨ Fuse pets to make them bigger and stronger
🏆 Hit the leaderboards with your rarest hatch ever!

Can you hatch a 1 in a billion pet? 👀

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for updates!
